Scaffold (mechanical)"},{"id":"F1:L0150","text":""},{"id":"F1:L0151","text":"**The deck:**"},{"id":"F1:L0152","text":""},{"id":"F1:L0153","text":"- `mkdir -p <base>/<slug>/` and copy `template/` into it — in an"},{"id":"F1:L0154","text":"  **integrated base (iii)** copy `template/src/` only and skip `index.html`"},{"id":"F1:L0155","text":"  and `src/main.tsx` (the site's `[slug]/index.astro` route provides the"},{"id":"F1:L0156","text":"  document shell and mounts `src/App.tsx`; the page title/description come"},{"id":"F1:L0157","text":"  from the spec frontmatter)."},{"id":"F1:L0158","text":"- Substitute the `__SPEC_MD_GLOB__` literal in `src/spec-docs.ts` with the"},{"id":"F1:L0159","text":"  computed relative path from `<base>/<slug>/src/` to"},{"id":"F1:L0160","text":"  `<specs-dir>/<slug>/*.md` (in iii: `../../../../tech-specs/<slug>/*.md`);"},{"id":"F1:L0161","text":"  in a standalone base also `__TITLE__` / `__DESCRIPTION__` in `index.html`."},{"id":"F1:L0162","text":"- **No per-deck install, no per-deck config, no lockfile.** Ensure deps once:"},{"id":"F1:L0163","text":"  workspace mode → `pnpm install` at the repo root (only if the base's deps"},{"id":"F1:L0164","text":"  are missing); standalone mode → `pnpm install --ignore-workspace` in"},{"id":"F1:L0165","text":"  `<base>` (commit the generated lockfile)."},{"id":"F1:L0166","text":""},{"id":"F1:L0167","text":"**Registration:** write or update the YAML frontmatter block at the top of"},{"id":"F1:L0168","text":"`tech-specs/<slug>/README.md` (schema in `reference/hosting.md`): title +"},{"id":"F1:L0169","text":"tagline from the approved hero, `date: YYYY-MM-DD` (day precision — the"},{"id":"F1:L0170","text":"roadmap timeline orders and labels by it), 0–4 tags, `status: draft`."},{"id":"F1:L0171","text":"There is no central manifest — the build aggregates every spec's frontmatter,"},{"id":"F1:L0172","text":"so this run touches nothing shared. A promotion = the component file **plus its `COMPONENTS.md` entry in the"},{"id":"F1:L0214","text":"   same change**. An unregistered shared component is a defect (the base's"},{"id":"F1:L0215","text":"   registry check warns — `scripts/validate-roadmap.ts` in iii, `build.mjs`"},{"id":"F1:L0216","text":"   standalone; strict mode makes it fatal)."},{"id":"F1:L0217","text":"4. Never fork a shared component into the deck to tweak it — extend it via"},{"id":"F1:L0218","text":"   additive, non-breaking props, or build a genuinely different deck-local"},{"id":"F1:L0219","text":"   one. **Modifying an existing shared component requires explicit user"},{"id":"F1:L0220","text":"   approval** (it re-renders every other deck)."},{"id":"F1:L0221","text":""},{"id":"F1:L0222","text":"**Built-in spec viewer — do not delete.** Every deck ships the `#/spec` page:"},{"id":"F1:L0223","text":"the template wires `spec-docs.ts` (the compile-time glob over the paired"},{"id":"F1:L0224","text":"spec's markdown) into `@lib/pages/SpecPage` via `PAGES.spec`, and the shared"},{"id":"F1:L0225","text":"`TopNav` renders the `spec` link. The shared markdown renderer strips the"},{"id":"F1:L0226","text":"frontmatter block. It needs no per-deck content — leave the wiring in place."},{"id":"F1:L0227","text":""},{"id":"F1:L0228","text":"### 5. Verify — THE SECOND GATE"},{"id":"F1:L0229","text":""},{"id":"F1:L0230","text":"All commands run from `<base>`'s package (iii: `pnpm --filter iii-website"},{"id":"F1:L0231","text":"<script>` from the repo root; standalone: inside `<base>`):"},{"id":"F1:L0232","text":""},{"id":"F1:L0233","text":"- `pnpm type-check` — the whole roadmap project (shared src + gallery + every"},{"id":"F1:L0234","text":"  deck) must pass strict; fix every error."},{"id":"F1:L0235","text":"- The build must succeed with zero frontmatter-validation or registry-parity"},{"id":"F1:L0236","text":"  warnings — iii: `pnpm build` (the site build runs the roadmap contract"},{"id":"F1:L0237","text":"  checks and emits `dist/roadmap/<slug>/`); standalone: `node build.mjs"},{"id":"F1:L0238","text":"  --only=<slug>`."},{"id":"F1:L0239","text":"- `pnpm dev` in the background, then dogfood with the **`/browse` skill**"},{"id":"F1:L0240","text":"  (never `mcp__claude-in-chrome__*`): load"},{"id":"F1:L0241","text":"  `http://localhost:4321/roadmap/<slug>/` (standalone: `:5173/<slug>/`),"},{"id":"F1:L0242","text":"  click the map, run a stepper, toggle the theme, open a deep-dive, open"},{"id":"F1:L0243","text":"  `#/spec` and confirm every markdown file renders (mermaid fences live, no"},{"id":"F1:L0244","text":"  raw frontmatter). Zero console errors; no horizontal body scroll at 375px."},{"id":"F1:L0245","text":"- `pnpm build && pnpm preview`, then `/browse"},{"id":"F1:L0246","text":"  http://localhost:4321/roadmap/` (standalone: `:4173/`): the spec appears on"},{"id":"F1:L0247","text":"  the roadmap timeline in date order under its month, its card shows the"},{"id":"F1:L0248","text":"  frontmatter title/tagline/tags with the day marker in the timeline gutter,"},{"id":"F1:L0249","text":"  and clicking it lands on `/roadmap/<slug>/`. If the spec previously served"},{"id":"F1:L0250","text":"  the md-only viewer, confirm the deck replaced it at the same URL."},{"id":"F1:L0251","text":"- **If anything under `<base>/src/` was touched (a promotion): run the full"},{"id":"F1:L0252","text":"  site build** — a shared change must not break sibling decks."},{"id":"F1:L0253","text":"- Run `reference/quality-bar.md` end to end; fix anything red."},{"id":"F1:L0254","text":""},{"id":"F1:L0255","text":"### 6. Hand off"},{"id":"F1:L0256","text":""},{"id":"F1:L0257","text":"Report: the deck path (`<base>/<slug>/`), the dev URL, the slide list, which"},{"id":"F1:L0258","text":"interactions are live, the frontmatter written, and any promoted components"},{"id":"F1:L0259","text":"(with their registry entries). Offer to flip `status: draft` → `live`."},{"id":"F1:L0260","text":"Deploy is not a step: **in iii, merging to main ships everything via"},{"id":"F1:L0261","text":"`.github/workflows/deploy-website.yml` to `iii.dev/roadmap/<slug>/`**; in"},{"id":"F1:L0262","text":"other repos `dist/` is a portable static site for whatever CI they use. Do"},{"id":"F1:L0263","text":"**not** commit, push, or configure hosting unless asked. Never run `vercel`."},{"id":"F1:L0264","text":""},{"id":"F1:L0265","text":"## Rules"},{"id":"F1:L0266","text":""},{"id":"F1:L0267","text":"- **The shared layer is law**: never edit `<base>/src/**`, the base's build"},{"id":"F1:L0268","text":"  glue (iii: `website/src/pages/roadmap/` and `scripts/validate-roadmap.ts`;"},{"id":"F1:L0269","text":"  standalone: `build.mjs` and `vite.config.ts`), tsconfigs, `package.json`,"},{"id":"F1:L0270","text":"  or the gallery in a deck run."},{"id":"F1:L0271","text":"  Sole exception: additive component promotion under"},{"id":"F1:L0272","text":"  `reference/component-standards.md`, always paired with a `COMPONENTS.md`"},{"id":"F1:L0273","text":"  entry."},{"id":"F1:L0274","text":"- A deck run's write surface is `<base>/<slug>/**` plus the frontmatter block"},{"id":"F1:L0275","text":"  of `tech-specs/<slug>/README.md`. Nothing else."},{"id":"F1:L0276","text":"- `tech-specs/` holds markdown only. Never write a non-md file there; never"},{"id":"F1:L0277","text":"  create a `presentation/` directory inside it."},{"id":"F1:L0278","text":"- Reuse first: consult `COMPONENTS.md` before building any visual; the repo"},{"id":"F1:L0279","text":"  registry outranks the bundled catalog."},{"id":"F1:L0280","text":"- Slug = the spec directory basename, used identically as the deck dir and the"},{"id":"F1:L0281","text":"  URL. Never prettify it. `slug` is never a frontmatter field."},{"id":"F1:L0282","text":"- One claim per slide. Put depth behind a `<SpecSheet>` (`<details>`), closed"},{"id":"F1:L0283","text":"  by default — execs skim, engineers drill."},{"id":"F1:L0284","text":"- Ration the accent (success / active / CTA only). Lowercase copy; identifiers"},{"id":"F1:L0285","text":"  keep their casing. No em-dashes. No \"robust / comprehensive / crucial /"},{"id":"F1:L0286","text":"  seamless / unlock\"."},{"id":"F1:L0287","text":"- Ground every claim in the spec. Keep one honest trade-offs/open-questions"},{"id":"F1:L0288","text":"  beat — honesty reads as credibility."},{"id":"F1:L0289","text":"- Quantify the win: use the spec's numbers verbatim; if you compute one, say so."},{"id":"F1:L0290","text":""},{"id":"F1:L0291","text":"## Decisions"},{"id":"F1:L0292","text":""},{"id":"F1:L0293","text":"Ask the user: the narrative outline (Phase 2, always); output location when"},{"id":"F1:L0294","text":"occupied; audience tilt (execs vs engineers; default balanced); fonts offline"},{"id":"F1:L0295","text":"vs CDN (default CDN); scope cap when a spec has many domain docs; first-run"},{"id":"F1:L0296","text":"base location + gallery identity + the `pnpm-workspace.yaml` edit; any"},{"id":"F1:L0297","text":"**modification** to an existing shared component; flipping `status` to `live`."},{"id":"F1:L0298","text":""},{"id":"F1:L0299","text":"Decide yourself: which archetype each slide uses; slide order within the arc;"},{"id":"F1:L0300","text":"hero line and stats; SVG coordinates and step counts; what goes behind a"},{"id":"F1:L0301","text":"`<details>`; copy voice; the frontmatter field values; deck-local vs promote"},{"id":"F1:L0302","text":"per the component protocol (announce promotions in the outline and hand-off —"},{"id":"F1:L0303","text":"don't ask). Everything under `<base>/src/` and the build glue is settled —"},{"id":"F1:L0304","text":"never re-litigate it in a deck run."},{"id":"F1:L0305","text":""},{"id":"F1:L0306","text":"## Verify"},{"id":"F1:L0307","text":""},{"id":"F1:L0308","text":"`pnpm type-check` and the roadmap build (iii: `pnpm --filter iii-website"},{"id":"F1:L0309","text":"build`; standalone: `node build.mjs --only=<slug>`) are green with zero"},{"id":"F1:L0310","text":"registry/frontmatter warnings; `/browse` shows zero console errors, working"},{"id":"F1:L0311","text":"interactions, and a frontmatter-free `#/spec`; the roadmap timeline lists the"},{"id":"F1:L0312","text":"spec in date order, its card rendered from the frontmatter; `reference/quality-bar.md` passes; a promotion ran the full"},{"id":"F1:L0313","text":"build (`reference/hosting.md` has the layout this all serves)."}],"source_sha256":"16916565b2b0a93bb5d6d800b382e3adc175e527d10279c8eff3d1aae5b12b9c"},{"file":"base/COMPONENTS.md","file_id":"F2","lines":[{"id":"F2:L0001","text":"# component registry"},{"id":"F2:L0002","text":""},{"id":"F2:L0003","text":"every shared file under `src/` has exactly one entry here (heading = file"},{"id":"F2:L0004","text":"basename). before building any visual for a deck, read this file — **reuse"},{"id":"F2:L0005","text":"first**. to add a component, meet the checklist in the presentation skill's"},{"id":"F2:L0006","text":"`reference/component-standards.md`, then append an entry in alphabetical order"},{"id":"F2:L0007","text":"within its kind. `node build.mjs` warns when a src file has no entry (or an"},{"id":"F2:L0008","text":"entry has no file);
